title: Pier Canvas default UI
description: Desktop-tool density and pier/canvas primitives only — calm, scannable overview chrome.
rules: Prefer Frame + Stack + Row + Text hierarchy
Single-line controls density aligns with host 28px
Use Badge for status, not decorative emoji
Tables for commands/defaults; prose for narrative only
One primary focus per view (squint test)
Mix open sections with cards; do not wrap every block in the same card
forbidden: rainbow status colors outside semantic Badge variants
agentPrompt: Apply Pier desktop-tool visual discipline. pier/canvas only. No marketing chrome. Semantic badges. Clear hierarchy. Prefer tables for inventories. See references/authoring.md and sdk/.
